_comment: plan-quests.md C4, quest 1 of 4 — the talk_to verb, and the quest that demonstrates D3's retroactive credit on purpose: a player who has already spoken to the farmer or the crier cascades straight to the report stage on accepting, and that is better met on a deliberately trivial errand than on a real one. Offered and turned in by the Hermit, who stands ~3 units from both targets. Reward: 150 XP (half of the level-1 requirement) and nothing else — this is the tutorial-shaped quest. Prose cut ≥50 % + tracker authored with conversation-journal Q4 (the 'north field' direction went with the cut — §15's invented-geography rule).
title: Faces of the Village

stages.journal: Two people worth knowing, says the hermit: the farmer at his field and the crier in the square. Be seen by both.
I have met the farmer and heard the crier. The hermit wanted to know how it went.
The village knows my face now. Out here, the hermit says, that is worth more than a sharp edge.
